I removed the two `as string` casts from the new `setValidationMany` code in `packages/nodes-base/nodes/KoBoToolbox/KoBoToolbox.node.ts`. Each value is now read into a variable and narrowed with `typeof x === 'string'`. A non-string value becomes an empty string.

I didn't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked. I also didn't re-check the diff for other new `as` casts after the edit. The earlier scan of the diff found only those two.

The existing `as string` casts on the other operations were already there, so I left them alone.
